Dabei bringst du deine langjährige Erfahrung ein, um Standards, Automatisierungslösungen und Sicherheitskonzepte in der Cloud-Umgebung weiterzuentwickeln. Du arbeitest eng mit verschiedenen Stakeholdern zusammen, um technische Lösungen verständlich zu vermitteln und in nachhaltige Gesamtkonzepte zu überführen. Durch dein strategisches und zugleich pragmatisches Vorgehen trägst du entscheidend dazu bei, Innovationen in der Cloud-Infrastruktur voranzubringen. Verantwortung Verantwortung für Design, Betrieb und kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung einer modernen Cloud- und Plattforminfrastruktur mit Schwerpunkt Microsoft Azure sowie ergänzend AWS und Google Cloud. Planung, Implementierung und Optimierung skalierbarer Cloud-Lösungen für geschäftskritische Applikationen, Plattformen und digitale Services. Sicherstellung eines stabilen Cloud-Betriebs durch den Einsatz moderner Observability-, Monitoring-, Logging- und Alerting-Lösungen sowie kontinuierliche Performance- und Kostenoptimierung (FinOps). Entwicklung automatisierter Bereitstellungs- und Betriebsprozesse mit Infrastructure as Code, Terraform, Bicep, PowerShell, Python sowie modernen DevOps- und GitOps-Methoden. Umsetzung von Sicherheits- und Governance-Anforderungen in den Bereichen Cloud Security, Identity & Access Management, Microsoft Entra ID, Netzwerksegmentierung, Verschlüsselung, Backup und Business Continuity. Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Enterprise Architects, Security Engineers, DevOps-, Infrastruktur- und Applikationsteams bei Cloud-Migrationen, Modernisierungen und Transformationsprojekten. Analyse und nachhaltige Behebung komplexer Störungen im 3rd-Level-Support sowie Erstellung technischer Dokumentationen und Betriebsrichtlinien. Evaluation neuer Cloud-Services, Plattformtechnologien und Best Practices zur kontinuierlichen Weiterentwicklung der Multi-Cloud-Strategie. Qualifikationen Abgeschlossenes Studium oder Ausbildung im Bereich Informatik oder eine vergleichbare technische Qualifikation. Mehrjährige Erfahrung im Engineering und Betrieb von Azure Cloud Services sowie idealerweise Kenntnisse in AWS oder Google Cloud Platform. Fundierte Kenntnisse in Terraform, Bicep, PowerShell, Python, Azure CLI oder vergleichbaren Automatisierungs- und IaC-Technologien. Erfahrung mit Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS), Container-Technologien, Serverless Services, Azure Networking sowie modernen Cloud-Plattformdiensten ist von Vorteil. Gute Kenntnisse in Azure DevOps, GitHub, GitLab, CI/CD-Pipelines sowie Infrastructure Automation. Verständnis moderner Cloud-Architekturen, Zero Trust, IAM, Microsoft Entra ID, Cloud Governance, Security- und Compliance-Anforderungen. Strukturierte, selbstständige Arbeitsweise sowie Freude an innovativen Cloud-Technologien und der Zusammenarbeit in interdisziplinären Teams. Sehr gute Deutsch- sowie gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift. review_candidates.description: Description Manage a team that maintains cloud infrastructure for global data center operations! AWS is looking for technology managers with experience in people management, strong technical understanding and the drive and vision to take AWS Data Center Operations to the next level. The successful candidate will have experience creating/devising strategies, mentoring people at all levels, sponsoring projects, and proposing technical solutions. This position involves leading teams in hardware and network diagnostics followed by physical repair and includes participation in an on-call rotation. AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help. You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion. Key job responsibilities The successful candidate will be operationally responsible for a Data Center. Some high-level responsibilities include: Prioritize and assign trouble tickets to data center technicians and operators Manage the performance of a diverse team(s) of data center operation professionals with varying skills across different locations Developing Career Paths for the employees and to make updates in our internal tools. Recruit and train data technicians to ensure appropriate staffing levels Ensure effective and efficient management of day to day data center operations including queue management, 7/24 shift arrangement and hardware logistics Fast learn or act as the subject matter expert across all aspects in data center operations Ensure all operational KPIs and metrics are being measured and met Inspire and guide improvement in team process, technology innovation and automation Manage Large Scale Events (outages) and act as the call leader Manage and improve the work-flows and through-put for data centers operations Recommend, document, and oversee policies and procedures to meet industry best practices and to meet required SLAs Maintain the on-call schedule coordinating absence and vacations Be passionate about the quality and quantity of services being provided, and continuously strive to improve our Customer Experience This role supports data centers in various operational stages. Work prioritization, organizational skills, effective communication, and the ability to react quickly are critical to being successful. Build custom SharePoint components  and solutions using SPFx, Power Automate, and Microsoft Graph / REST APIs. Administer and support SharePoint Online environments , including site collections, permissions, security groups, content types, term store, and search configuration. Design, build, and configure Copilot agents  (using Copilot Studio or similar tools) that leverage SharePoint and other data sources to enable AI powered knowledge retrieval, self-service, and productivity scenarios. Implement governance, security, and compliance best practices across SharePoint and Copilot solutions , partnering with client IT and security teams to align with organizational policies. Integrate SharePoint with other Microsoft 365 service s (Teams, OneDrive, Viva, Power BI) and line of business systems to create cohesive digital workplace experiences. Support implementation efforts across the delivery lifecycle , including solution design, configuration, customization, testing, deployment, and post-go-live support. Monitor and optimize SharePoint and Copilot solutions  using analytics and feedback; iterate information architecture, prompts, and flows to improve usability and outcomes. Contribute to client enablement and adoption  through documentation, technical runbooks, training support, and change enablement activities. Stay current on Microsoft 365, SharePoint, Power Platform, and Copilot roadmap and capabilities , share learnings and reusable assets within Slalom’s communities of practice. What You’ll Bring Experience designing, developing, and administering SharePoint Online solutions , including modern sites, permissions, information architecture, and search. Hands‑on experience with SharePoint development and customization  using SPFx, JavaScript/TypeScript, HTML/CSS, and Microsoft Graph / REST APIs. Practical experience with Power Platform  (Power Automate; Dataverse a plus) to extend and automate SharePoint and Microsoft 365 solutions. Demonstrated experience building or configuring Copilot agents  or similar AI/chatbot solutions (e.g., Copilot Studio, Power Virtual Agents), including connecting to SharePoint and other enterprise data sources. Understanding of Microsoft 365 security, compliance, and governance concepts  (Entra ID/Azure AD, groups, conditional access, DLP, sensitivity/retention labels) and how they apply to SharePoint and Copilot. Strong problem-solving and troubleshooting  skills across SharePoint, Microsoft 365, and integrations, with the ability to diagnose and resolve complex issues. Ability to work directly with clients —gathering requirements, explaining options, and translating business needs into practical, human-centered technical solutions. Strong collaboration and communication skills , with comfort working across technical and nontechnical stakeholders in a consulting or client facing environment. A growth mindset , including curiosity about emerging Microsoft 365 and AI capabilities, willingness to learn, and openness to feedback.
